Mira Singh: Quick sync — v2 rollout blockers. Can owners confirm status for SDK headers, proxy shim, and telemetry tags? Short answers pls.
Aaron Lee: SDK PR merged to main but CI flaky on macOS unit tests. Rerunning now, ETA EOD.
Olga Petrov: Proxy team: shadowing traffic looks good. One snag — need header mapping for client trace IDs.
Samir Patel: I can own header mapping. Quick q: do we honor `x-rw-version` or use `accept-version` header?
Mira Singh: Prefer `x-rw-version` per spec. Devex asked we support `accept-version` as a fallback for older SDKs.
devex-bot: Reminder: SDK compatibility guide updated — https://go.redwood/docs/sdk/compat
Aaron Lee: Will add fallback parsing and tests. If someone can approve #3198 after CI, I'll cut the canary.
Olga Petrov: Will approve once CI passes. FYI SRE saw ~3% 503s on an earlier canary run — investigating.
SRE-Bot: Alert: canary-3 reported increased 5xx between 10:32–10:40 UTC; not correlated with traffic spike.
Samir Patel: If 503s persist, playbook should include automatic route fallback to v1 for flagged customers. Can we add that?
Mira Singh: Yes — adding circuit-breaker + route fallback to the rollout playbook. Samir, can you create the PR for header mapping + fallback?
Samir Patel: On it. Also flagging a serialization regression in embeddings call — tagging @Aaron for triage.
Aaron Lee: I'll look at the serialization issue after the test rerun, should be quick.
devex-bot: PR checklist: add migration note for SDKs, update changelog, and include sample header usage.
Mira Singh: Thanks — quick ask: owners, drop final ETA here by 18:00 PT so PM can update release notes.
Aaron Lee: EOD PT for tests + PR approval (barring flaky CI).
Olga Petrov: Proxy mapping + approval by 16:00 PT.
Samir Patel: Header PR + fallback by 17:30 PT.
Mira Singh: Perfect. I'll draft the roll-forward doc and ping security for the KMS/tokens note.
devex-bot: Reminder: office-hours today 15:00 PT if anyone wants live migration Q&A.
